title: Paid repair: priced, held, repaired in-house, delivered
description: Imported by REPAIR-0 from runtime/executive/mission-imports/2026-10-22-diagnosis-and-paid-repair.json. Source ticket: REPAIR-1.
objective: From a diagnosis, the customer picks findings to repair, sees the price, and agrees. Stripe holds the amount, the job lands in the In-House Dev queue, engineers repair it, and delivery as a pull request or download captures the charge.
risks: Needs MS-2026-0003: a Stripe customer with a saved payment method, and Stripe keys only in Runtime's environment.
A card hold expires after about 7 days; a job expected to take longer is charged on agreement, and the pop-up says so before they agree.
Pushing a pull request needs write access the customer grants; without it the repair is delivered as a download.

tasks.title: The owner publishes the repair rate table
acceptanceCriteria: A price per finding severity and category, and a minimum per job, set by the owner and versioned
Every quote records the rate table version it used

tasks.title: Repair pop-up
acceptanceCriteria: Shows the chosen findings, the price from the rate table, when the card is charged, and what is delivered
Nothing is held or charged until the customer agrees
Built in the Knowledge Operations design and approved visually

tasks.title: Stripe hold and capture
acceptanceCriteria: Agreeing creates a manual-capture PaymentIntent on the saved card
Delivery captures it; cancelling releases it
Every Stripe event is verified by signature and recorded once

tasks.title: Engagement record in Runtime
acceptanceCriteria: Holds customer, project, chosen findings, quote, payment state, assignee, status and full history
Statuses: requested, held, in progress, in review, delivered, cancelled

tasks.title: In-House Dev Engagements queue
acceptanceCriteria: Engineers see, take and work each engagement, with its audit and fix plan one click away
The console from MS-2026-0011 (Tools, Projects, Attention) sits beside the queue

tasks.title: Delivery
acceptanceCriteria: A pull request to the customer's repository when KoreLumina has write access, otherwise a download of the repaired project
A re-audit after repair is attached to the delivery

validationPlan: A Stripe test-mode repair goes from agreement to hold to delivery to capture
